title: Crypto has become the modern form of money
author: ToxicNyxa
selftext:
for a lot of younger professionals and investors, crypto feels like “the next big thing.” some people just buy a little and hold, hoping it moons someday, while more active traders are constantly buying and selling trying to squeeze out as much profit as they can.

  
but jumping into crypto without any kind of plan is pretty risky. there are tons of different coins and tokens now, and a bunch of them will probably vanish in a few years and never give your money back. with a decent strategy though, you might catch something that blows up like bitcoin did. or maybe in a few years crypto actually does replace a big chunk of traditional money and you end up being one of the early people who benefited from it. that kind of thinking is why crypto keeps getting more popular.

  
it’s also already way more popular than it was 1–2 years ago, and the amount of tools for storing and trading it keeps growing too. that basically means we have to be a bit picky and choose what actually works best. binance is still my favorite exchange, but when it comes to wallets it’s not that simple. metamask and trust wallet just aren’t that convenient for me.

  
recently I found a new wallet that’s supposed to go into beta at the end of this month called sendcrypto. it looks a lot better for my use case. the fees are super low (almost nothing), the devs are talking about a pretty big rewards / promo program, and the coolest thing is you can send crypto directly to a friend from your phone’s contact list. I haven’t seen that feature in any other wallet so far.
